summary.headline: Summary of First-Class Mail sent per household for fiscal year 2024.

statements.text: For All households, First-Class Mail sent per household was 26.6 pieces per household per year in FY2024.
First-Class Mail sent per household decreased by 6.8 pieces per household per year from the previous year across the FY2024 methodology break.
First-Class Mail sent per household fell by 25.6 pieces per household per year from 2019 to FY2024 across the FY2024 methodology break.

caveats: From the FY2024 report, results are published as pieces per household per year, and the survey contractor changed (NuStats to RCF). The FY2024 report restated 2014-2023 on its own basis, so its values for those years can differ slightly from earlier reports (e.g. bills paid by mail in 2014: 34% in FY2023, 33% in FY2024).

FY2025 used a new survey design (renamed the Household Mail Survey); Q1 was still covered by the old survey. Age bands changed to Under 45 / 45-64 / 65+ (previously 18-34 / 35-54 / 55+), and 'Large MSA' was redefined in January 2025 from the top 30 metros to metros of 1 million or more.

summary.headline: Long-term analysis of First-Class Mail sent per household across available years.

statements.text: For All households, the metric fcm-sent-per-household fell by 53.7 pieces per household per year from the fiscal year 2014 to the fiscal year 2024 across the FY2024 methodology break.
For All households, the metric fcm-sent-per-household decreased by 25.6 pieces per household per year from the fiscal year 2019 to the fiscal year 2024 across the FY2024 methodology break.
For All households, the metric fcm-sent-per-household declined by 6.8 pieces per household per year from the fiscal year 2023 to the fiscal year 2024 across the FY2024 methodology break.

For All households, the projected value for fcm-sent-per-household in the fiscal year 2025 is a projected 25.0 pieces per household per year with an 80% prediction interval 18.4 to 31.6, beating the naive baseline.

For All households, the projected value for fcm-sent-per-household in the fiscal year 2029 is a projected 5.1 pieces per household per year with an 80% prediction interval 0.0 to 19.9, beating the naive baseline.

caveats: Beginning in 2010, diary data were restated because of changes in weighting methodology (Appendix A8 table notes). Values before 2010 use the earlier weighting.

From the FY2024 report, results are published as pieces per household per year, and the survey contractor changed (NuStats to RCF). The FY2024 report restated 2014-2023 on its own basis, so its values for those years can differ slightly from earlier reports (e.g. bills paid by mail in 2014: 34% in FY2023, 33% in FY2024).

FY2025 used a new survey design (renamed the Household Mail Survey); Q1 was still covered by the old survey. Age bands changed to Under 45 / 45-64 / 65+ (previously 18-34 / 35-54 / 55+), and 'Large MSA' was redefined in January 2025 from the top 30 metros to metros of 1 million or more.
